ambiguities_or_notes: The Luke epigraph and Biblical allusions are translated from Tolstoy's Russian wording rather than replaced by a standard English Bible text.
The repeated gate scene, the accuser's repeated inventory of sins, and the refrain 'It was the same with me' are preserved rather than compressed.
Иоанн Богослов is rendered by the traditional Russian-Christian title 'John the Theologian'; 'the sword of the Ammonites' and the ewe-lamb image are kept close to the source.
